text: Whether this device reconverts incoming PCM to DSD, and at what rate. The shape is unmistakable and the page will not say it. The converters are « 16xDSD » and « MDAT2 DSP works in harmony with the 16xDSD DACs, processing audio in real-time » - a discrete stage that runs at DSD1024 with a DSP in front of it, fed inputs that top out at 24/192 PCM and DSD128. Something upstream must be taking 192 kHz PCM to DSD1024, and pcm_reconverted_to_dsd would be the field for it. The page never states it. Nagra says it in one sentence (« Every input signal is converted into DSD 256 format ») and APL HiFi in another (« All PCM rates from the digital sources are converted to DSD, prior to D/A conversion »), both recorded today; this maker, whose founder built the first DSD systems, says only that its DSP works « in harmony with » the DACs. No fact is written. The inference is strong, which is the reason to be careful rather than a reason to proceed.
what_would_resolve_it: The DA2i brochure or manual, both linked from the product page and neither read. Failing that, one sentence from EMM Labs. Do NOT resolve it from the sister MA3i page, which carries the same bullets and says no more, nor from the architecture: a 16xDSD stage is evidence of what the stage does, not of what happens to the signal before it.
